_doc: Reviewed term-gloss decisions. Single source of truth for the term-gloss standard. Enforced by invariants.py::check_claim_text_term_gloss. defects = garbled/obsolete forms that must NEVER appear in front-facing claim_text OR verbatim (blatant book defects, fixed everywhere). common_swaps = obscure common name -> simpler, more-recognizable common name, applied to claim_text ONLY; the sacred verbatim keeps Wallach's own common name (only defects are fixed there); an entry may also add a plain gloss to a bare/obscure scientific genus. abbrev_require_explained = genuinely obscure abbreviations that MUST be spelled out somewhere in the same claim_text (any listed trigger phrase present, case-insensitive); universally-grasped acronyms (DNA/RNA/AIDS/HIV/CPR/UV/IQ/MS/PMS/ADD/ADHD/USDA/FDA/MSG/SIDS/EFA/RDA) are intentionally NOT enforced -- a layperson understands them immediately and over-parenthesizing dense summaries hurts readability. glossary_key_denylist = normalized glossary KEYS (a term or an alias in dashboard/assets/data/glossary.json) that were removed for over-firing and may never be re-registered; the match is on the NORMALIZED key EXACTLY (lower-cased, [\s-] runs -> one space, the same normalization state/glossary.ts applies), so a multi-word key that merely CONTAINS the word ('oxidation-reduction', 'reduced glutathione') is untouched by construction. Enforced by invariants.py::check_glossary_keys_denylisted.

glossary_key_denylist.reduced: removed 2026-08-02 with the 'reduce in chemistry' entry: measured across 9,211 front-facing blocks it fired 105 dotted-underline tooltips, every one the ordinary-English sense ('reduced immune status', 'reduced cognition') and NONE the chemistry sense. The chemistry concept keeps its own entries, 'redox' and 'oxidation-reduction' (9 correct firings).
glossary_key_denylist.reduction: removed 2026-08-02, same entry: 24 firings, all ordinary-English ('a reduction in inflammation markers', 'the reduction or absence of acid'). Denylisted alongside 'reduced' because removing only the flagged alias would have left this one over-firing.
glossary_key_denylist.reduce: never registered; denylisted 2026-08-02 as the same common-word family. The R9 lesson from term_gloss_ratified_present is that a literal key match misses near-variants, so the morphological family is closed rather than the one word that happened to be reported.
glossary_key_denylist.reducing: never registered; denylisted 2026-08-02 as the same common-word family (see 'reduce').
